documents.title: Extra Ordinary General Meeting ('EOGM') Of The Members Of U. Y. Fincorp Limited Will Be Held On Wednesday, The 25Th Day Of November, 2026 At 11:00 A.M.

analysis.summary: During FY 2025-26, U. Y. Fincorp Limited achieved revenue from operations of ₹16,164.13 Lakhs and a profit before tax of ₹6,664.38 Lakhs, while expanding its lending portfolio to ₹35,652.97 Lakhs. The company diversified its product offerings by introducing Equipment Financing under the "GrowU.money" brand and expanding small-ticket personal and business loans via a partnership with Fintech Cloud Private Limited under the "Fundobaba" brand. Management emphasized disciplined growth, prudent risk management, and strong asset quality backed by adequate internal financial controls.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects that the growing financing requirements of businesses and individuals, along with digital adoption and formalisation, will provide a strong foundation for future financial intermediation.
demand_outlook.quote: The growing financing requirements of businesses and individuals, increasing financial inclusion, digital adoption and the continuing formalisation of economic activity provide a strong foundation for the future of financial intermediation.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that the operating environment will remain competitive and subject to evolving regulations, credit risks, interest-rate movements, and economic cycle changes.
demand_outlook.quote: However, we also recognise that the operating environment will remain competitive and subject to evolving regulations, credit risks, interest-rate movements and changes in the broader economic cycle.

demand_outlook.claim: India's continued economic development, business formalisation, organised credit penetration, and MSME growth provide a favourable long-term opportunity for the business.
demand_outlook.quote: India's continued economic development, formalisation of businesses, increasing penetration of organised credit and growth of MSMEs provide a favourable long-term opportunity for our business.

demand_outlook.claim: Advanced economies experienced slower growth due to high interest rates and weakened consumer spending, whereas emerging markets in Asia maintained better economic momentum.
demand_outlook.quote: While advanced economies like the U.S. and the Eurozone experienced slower growth due to high interest rates and weakened consumer spending, emerging markets, particularly in Asia, maintained better economic momentum, driven by domestic demand and technology sector growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Inflationary pressures eased in most economies through the course of the year.
demand_outlook.quote: Inflationary pressures eased in most economies through the course of the year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand for credit is likely to remain strong, especially among MSMEs and retail, and is projected to grow by 13.5-14.0 percent.
demand_outlook.quote: As the country progresses, demand for credit is likely to remain strong, especially among Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) and retail, and is projected to grow by 13.5-14.0 per cent.

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered into a contractual joint venture agreement with Fintech Cloud Private Limited for small-ticket personal and business loan expansion under the "FUNDOBABA" brand.
capex_expansion.quote: During the period under review, the Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held on 9th April, 2025, inter alia considered and approved the contractual joint venture agreement dated 9th April, 2025 entered into by the Company with Fintech Cloud Private Limited (FCPL) for expansion of its business into the field on small ticket size Personal and Business Loan under its new brand name “FUNDOBABA”.

capex_expansion.claim: During FY 2025-26, the company introduced Equipment Financing under the "GrowU.money" brand to support eligible businesses and entrepreneurs.
capex_expansion.quote: During FY 2025–26, the Company further diversified its product portfolio by introducing Equipment Financing under the “GrowU.money” brand.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved the opening of a new branch office at Lucknow for expanding business operations under the brand name GrowU.Money.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year under review, the Board of Directors at its meeting held on 3rd May, 2024 inter alia considered and approved the proposal of opening of the Company’s new branch office at Lucknow for the purpose of expansion of its business operation in the area of Lucknow under the brand name “GrowU.Money”.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved a contractual joint venture agreement with Fintech Cloud Private Limited for expansion into small ticket-size personal and business loans under the brand name FUNDOBABA.
capex_expansion.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held on 9th April, 2025, inter alia considered and approved the contractual joint venture agreement dated 9th April, 2025 entered into by the Company with Fintech Cloud Private Limited (FCPL) for expansion of its business into the field on small ticket size Personal and Business Loan under its new brand name “FUNDOBABA”.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the company is expanding further into central and eastern Uttar Pradesh covering Prayagraj, Varanasi, Sonbhadra, Ayodhya, Deoria, and Gorakhpur regions.
capex_expansion.quote: Since GrowU has received positive response under its pilot project in the areas of lucknow and Kanpur, it is now inter alia expanding further into central and eastern Uttar Pradesh covering Prayagraj, Varanasi, Sonbhadra, Ayodhya, Deoria and Gorakhpur regions.

orders_capacity.claim: The lending portfolio reached ₹35,652.97 Lakhs as at March 31, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our lending portfolio also expanded meaningfully during the year, reaching ₹35,652.97 Lakhs as at March 31, 2026, compared with ₹27,457.34 Lakhs as at March 31, 2025.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has disbursed loans to more than 18,000 customers across India.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company has disbursed loans to more than 18,000 customers across India.

orders_capacity.claim: The company disbursed loans to more than 3,800 customers across more than 2 customer locations in Uttar Pradesh through its network of 2 branches and 6 business correspondents.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company had disbursed loan to more than 3,800 customers, across more than 2 Customer Locations in Uttar Pradesh, through its network of 2 branches, & 6 Business Correspondents.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported that the company ended the year with the highest ever disbursements and portfolio size.
orders_capacity.quote: The year 2023-24 has been a great one for us, as we ended the year with the highest ever disbursements and portfolio size, with the fully capacitized and diverse management team by Company's expansion into central and eastern Uttar Pradesh and many more.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors did not recommend any dividend for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The Directors of your Company do not recommend any dividend for the financial year ended 31st March, 2026 in order to plough back the resources for future growth.

capital_allocation.claim: The paid-up equity share capital as on March 31, 2026 was ₹9,511.92 Lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: The paid up equity share capital as on 31st March 2026 was ` 9,511.92 Lakhs.

capital_allocation.claim: The Directors did not recommend any dividend for the financial year ended March 31, 2025, to plough back resources for future growth.
capital_allocation.quote: The Directors of your Company do not recommend any dividend for the financial year ended 31st March, 2025 in order to plough back the resources for future growth.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management flagged geopolitical tensions, commodity price volatility, elevated global debt, and financial market uncertainties as factors influencing global economic activity.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions, changing trade policies, commodity price volatility, elevated global debt and uncertainty in international financial markets continued to influence economic activity across regions.

risks_headwinds.claim: The NBFC industry continues to face challenges related to asset quality, competition, funding conditions, interest-rate movements, and an evolving regulatory environment.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, the industry continues to face challenges relating to asset quality, competition, funding conditions, interest-rate movements and an evolving regulatory environment.

risks_headwinds.claim: The global economy faced ongoing geopolitical tensions, persistent inflationary pressures, and monetary policy adjustments.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the FY 2024-25, the global economy demonstrated modest growth amid ongoing geopolitical tensions, persistent inflationary pressures, and monetary policy adjustments.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that global economic uncertainty is contributed to by ongoing geopolitical conflicts, widespread elevation of debt, extreme weather conditions, and elections in many parts of the world.
risks_headwinds.quote: Multiple factors like the on-going geopolitical conflicts, wide-spread elevation of debt, extreme weather conditions and elections in many parts of the world continue to contribute to the uncertainty of the Global Economic Outlook.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to expand its operations in existing markets, selectively enter newer geographies, and explore organic and inorganic opportunities.
management_commitments.quote: We intend to build upon our existing strengths by expanding our operations in existing markets, selectively entering newer geographies and exploring organic as well as inorganic opportunities, while remaining within our risk appetite.

management_commitments.claim: Management commits to continuing its focus on asset quality, adequate liquidity, operational efficiency, product diversification, and customer reach.
management_commitments.quote: We will continue to focus on strengthening our asset quality, maintaining adequate liquidity, improving operational efficiency, diversifying our products and expanding our customer reach.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to continue its efforts toward mainstreaming financial inclusion and providing affordable credit to customers in the lower half of the socio-economic pyramid.
management_commitments.quote: The Company intends to continue its efforts of mainstreaming financial inclusion and providing affordable credit to customers in the lower half of the socio-economic pyramid.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
